datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly basis across South Sudan administrative units. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications (representing food insecurity severity) were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for multiple time periods in 2018, representing post-event or ongoing food security impact assessments.
